thread:
sara: Quick flag 1: were seeing fncall validator noise on dedicated us-east when route falls back to degen-model. Rejects mostly due to missing 'transaction_id' field - adapter returns [] in a minority of cases. Anyone seen adapter code path that might return list?

ben: Ive dug into the payment-adapter logs. There's a legacy codepath where we `return []` when downstream returns 204. The new validator expects `{transaction_id: string, status: string}` strictly.

oli: deploy-bot: can we get a sample payload? We need to see exact shapes.

deploy-bot: sampling initiated. capture id cap_981238. redacted samples will be available in 30m.

noor: billing question 1: if a fncall is rejected before tool invocation, are customers billed for the model tokens only or model + tool? currently console shows model tokens and tool tokens separately but attribution is fuzzy for rejects.

sara: good question. ops-team, can we add a flag to the telemetry event `fncall.reject` that indicates `invoked_tool: true|false` so billing can disambiguate?

ben: sure. I'll add an `invoked_tool` boolean to the event payload and backfill for the next 24h.

oli: UX request: in the console trace view, add a pill that says "validator=v2 (strict)" next to route and a hover that explains what fields were required. That will save us digging into schema docs mid-incident.

sara: +1. Also add a quick link to the adapter source line that returned the empty array (if we can stitch git blame into the trace).

noor: for immediate mitigation can we temporarily coerce empty arrays into `{}` at the gateway before validation? less risky than rolling back full strict-validate.

ben: we can do a small coercion middleware: if tool_response is array and empty -> replace with `{}` and set `coerced_by='gateway'`. But we should log `coercion=true` in the event.

deploy-bot: gatekeeper: rolling patch coercion-middleware v0.1 to canary (slice=5%).

oli: let's threshold it: if reject_rate drops below 0.3% after coercion, we keep it and open a tech debt PR to remove legacy array returns.

noor: and make sure billing shows `coerced_tool_response=true` so we don't double-bill for tool invocations that never happened.

ben: will do telemetry + billing flag.

sara: summary of action items: 1) capture samples (cap_981238), 2) add invoked_tool & coercion flags to telemetry, 3) deploy coercion middleware canary, 4) dashboard card for validate.rejects by adapter + canary vs prod.

oli: assigned. I'll update the incident thread when samples arrive. :eyes:

deploy-bot: sample cap_981238 ready (redacted). link: https://internal-redwood/samples/cap_981238

ben: looked at samples, adapter returned [] in 14/1200 recent calls. created PR to delete legacy path.

noor: excellent. we'll coordinate a billing audit after coercion is live.

sara: thanks team. closing loop after 24h observation.
